title: The relief column

branches.condition: Civilian relief arrives and Spear intercepts a patrol
branches.consequence: The relief traffic brings the Sorenne patrol within reach. A capable force fights and sustains its conditioning, disrupting civilian life further. A force too weakened to fight is disabled instead. Any of the three relief vessels can draw the patrol.

branches.condition: Civilian relief does not arrive and Spear intercepts a patrol
branches.consequence: The patrol is not found. The expedition disrupts traffic without achieving combat. Troop transport and a private commercial voyage do not draw this patrol.

branches.condition: Spear does not intercept a patrol
branches.consequence: Relief alone causes no attack. Spear must launch an interception for these consequences to occur.

guidance: Consider whether Navigation will deliver civilian relief and whether Spear will intercept the patrol. Existing vetoes and commitments restrict choices; they do not compel an otherwise legal order.
